description.value: The Esquimalt Branch is part of the Greater Victoria Public Library network, operated by the public Greater Victoria Public Library system serving multiple municipalities in the Capital Region. It is notable for housing a self-serve digitization space where patrons can preserve old photographs and documents—a unique feature within the GVPL system. Touring cyclists passing through Esquimalt will find a welcoming public space with public computers and a broad physical and digital collection.

The phone number 250-940-4875 appears on the website's Contact Us and FAQ pages but is absent from OSM tags. No cycling-specific amenities—bike parking, washrooms, or water refill—are explicitly mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, and OSM's internet_access=wlan tag cannot be treated as authoritative per the rules since the website does not explicitly confirm WiFi for patrons.
